classification.difficultyReason: Find the repeating coincidence interval and identify the first coincidence after a later time.

content.prompt: A yellow bulb flashes every 4 minutes and a blue bulb flashes every 7 minutes. If both bulbs flash together at 9 a.m., what is the first time after 10 a.m. that both bulbs will flash together?

answer.short:
10:24 a.m.

The bulbs flash together every 28 minutes.
answer.worked:
Non-zero multiples of 4 are $4,8,12,16,20,24,28,\ldots$.

Non-zero multiples of 7 are $7,14,21,28,\ldots$.

The LCM of 4 and 7 is 28, so the bulbs flash together every 28 minutes.

Starting from 9 a.m., the next times are 9:28 a.m., 9:56 a.m. and 10:24 a.m.

The first time after 10 a.m. is 10:24 a.m.
